```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_light())

library(brms)
library(tidybayes)
library(posterior)
```

## The data

The following is data from @tucker2019.
Loading the `.Rda` file attaches the data as `dat`.

```{r}
#| label: dat

load("data/tucker2019/MALD1_1_AllData.Rda")

dat <- as_tibble(dat)
dat
```

We do some data transformation for later.

```{r}
#| label: dat-transform

dat <- dat |> 
  mutate(
    RT_log = log(RT), PhonLev_log = log(PhonLev),
    IsWord = factor(IsWord, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
  )

dat_f <- dat |> 
  filter(RT > 0)

set.seed(3181)
dat_sample <- dat_f |> 
  filter(Subject %in% sample(unique(dat_f$Subject), 30)) |> 
  slice_sample(n = 150, by = Subject)
```

## Descriptive summaries and plots

```{r}
#| label: participants

dat |> 
  distinct(Subject) |> 
  count()

dat |> 
  count(IsWord) |> 
  mutate(prop = round(proportions(n) * 100))
```

Density plot of RTs for each participant and aggregated.

```{r}
#| label: rt-dens

dat |> 
  ggplot(aes(RT)) +
  geom_density(aes(group = Subject), colour = alpha("black", 0.1)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red")

```

There are several RT = 0.

```{r}
#| label: rt-0

dat |> 
  filter(RT == 0) |> 
  count()
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-0-dens

dat |> 
  filter(RT != 0) |> 
  ggplot(aes(RT)) +
  geom_density(aes(group = Subject), colour = alpha("black", 0.1)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red")
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-dens-z

dat |> 
  filter(RT > 0) |> 
  group_by(Subject) |> 
  mutate(
    RT_z = (RT - mean(RT)) / sd(RT)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(RT_z)) +
  geom_density(aes(group = Subject), colour = alpha("black", 0.1)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red") +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.1)
```

Let's use the filtered data which drops all RTs that are 0 ms. We can get a few summary measures.

```{r}
#| label: dat-f-summaries

dat_f |> 
  group_by(IsWord) |> 
  summarise(
    mean(RT), median(RT), sd(RT), min(RT), max(RT)
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: rt-dens-isword

dat_f |> 
  group_by(Subject) |> 
  mutate(
    RT_z = (RT - mean(RT)) / sd(RT)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(RT_z)) +
  geom_density(aes(group = Subject), colour = alpha("black", 0.1)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red") +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(vars(IsWord))
```


```{r}
#| label: rt-pl

dat_f |> 
  ggplot(aes(PhonLev_log, RT_log, colour = IsWord)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

## Data sample

```{r}
#| label: rt-pl-sample

dat_sample |> 
  ggplot(aes(PhonLev_log, RT_log, colour = IsWord)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

```{r}
#| label: dat-s-summaries

dat_sample |> distinct(Subject) |> count()
dat_sample |> distinct(Item, IsWord) |> count(IsWord)
dat_sample |> group_by(IsWord) |>
  summarise(mean(RT), median(RT), sd(RT), min(RT), max(RT))
dat_sample |> group_by(IsWord) |>
  summarise(mean(PhonLev_log), median(PhonLev_log), sd(PhonLev_log), min(PhonLev_log), max(PhonLev_log))
```
## Modelling

```{r}
#| label: centre

dat_sample <- dat_sample |> 
  mutate(
    PhonLev_logc = PhonLev_log - mean(PhonLev_log)
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: rt-bm

rt_bm <- brm(
  RT ~ IsWord * PhonLev_logc + (IsWord * PhonLev_logc | Subject),
  family = lognormal,
  data = dat_sample,
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(2),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 2743,
  file = "data/cache/rt_bm"
)

fixef(rt_bm)
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-bm-int

rt_draws <- as_draws_df(rt_bm)

rt_draws |> 
  ggplot(aes(`b_IsWordFALSE:PhonLev_logc`)) +
  stat_halfeye()

rt_draws |> 
  ggplot(aes(exp(`b_IsWordFALSE:PhonLev_logc`))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +
  stat_halfeye()
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-bm-cond

conditional_effects(rt_bm, "PhonLev_logc:IsWord")
```
